-- ============================================================================
-- warehouse_summary.sql
-- TPC-D S warehouse summary by country and state
-- Dialect : MySQL
-- Purpose : Group warehouses by country (w_country) and state (w_state),
--           compute count and square-footage aggregates (SUM / MIN / MAX).
-- Notes   : - NULL groups are preserved (MySQL GROUP BY keeps NULLs).
--           - w_warehouse_sq_ft is kept as raw integer values; no unit
--             conversion or guessing is applied.
--           - Read-only; no parameters, no warehouse-id filters.
-- Source  : tpcds.warehouse (REGISTERED_METADATA)
-- ============================================================================

SELECT
    w_country,
    w_state,
    COUNT(*)                 AS warehouse_count,
    SUM(w_warehouse_sq_ft)   AS total_warehouse_sq_ft,
    MIN(w_warehouse_sq_ft)   AS min_warehouse_sq_ft,
    MAX(w_warehouse_sq_ft)   AS max_warehouse_sq_ft
FROM tpcds.warehouse
GROUP BY
    w_country,
    w_state
ORDER BY
    w_country,
    w_state;
title: 仓库地区分布与面积汇总
description: 按国家及省州汇总仓库数量与面积字段原值，保留空分组；不推断面积单位。
